post.description:
1. Only a single root user (`root`) can exist per instance; subsequent attempts return `409 Conflict`.
2. The commercial license is validated online against `cloud_url` (configurable, defaults to `https://api.swanlab.cn/api`):
	1. An expired license returns `403 Forbidden`;
	2. A non-existent license returns `404 Not Found`;
	3. Upstream or network validation failures return `502 Bad Gateway`.
3. Returns `201 Created` upon successful initialization.
4. The root user is identified internally by `group.comment = root`.
5. Once validated online, a local license record is persisted for subsequent verification.
6. Commercial licenses require online activation; offline attempts return `403 Forbidden`.

201.description: Created: root user initialized successfully; returns the user profile

403.description: Forbidden (license validation failed): `License_Expired` (license has expired); `License_Verification_Failed` (invalid license token); `License_Activation_Expired` (activation deadline exceeded); `License_User_Count_Exceeded` (existing user count exceeds plan limit); `License_Activation_Failed` (online activation failed)

500.description: Internal Server Error: unexpected server error

servers.description: Self-hosted instance (replace with your instance domain)

401.description: Unauthorized: missing or invalid authentication credentials

403.description: Forbidden: insufficient permissions to create users, or `Max_Limit` exceeded (instance user limit reached; the entire batch operation is rolled back)

1. The root user can reset any user's password.
2. Non-root users can only change their own password.

200.description: OK: password updated successfully (empty response body)

401.description: Unauthorized: missing or invalid authentication credentials

403.description: Forbidden: non-root users cannot change another user's password

404.description: Not Found: target user does not exist

post.description: Deactivating a user revokes and deletes all of their API Keys and active sessions, while preserving their SSO `ProviderUser` bindings.

204.description: No Content: user deactivated and credentials revoked (empty response body)

401.description: Unauthorized: missing or invalid authentication credentials

403.description: Forbidden: insufficient permissions to deactivate this user

example.message: no permission to pause the user

404.description: Not Found: target user does not exist

409.description: Conflict: the root user (`root`) cannot be deactivated

servers.description: Self-hosted instance (replace with your instance domain)

204.description: No Content: user restored successfully (empty response body)

401.description: Unauthorized: missing or invalid authentication credentials

403.description: Forbidden: insufficient permissions to restore this user

example.message: no permission to unpause the user

404.description: Not Found: target user does not exist

servers.description: Self-hosted instance (replace with your instance domain)

post.description:
1. Only the root user (`root`) can delete users.
2. The root user cannot delete itself (returns `409 Conflict`).
3. Performs a soft delete: `status` on the `user` table and on the personal workspace in the `group` table (`type=PERSON`) is set to `DISABLED`.
4. Hard-deletes all persistent session records for the user from the `session` table.
5. Purges all cached sessions belonging to the user.
6. If the target user is an administrator (`OWNER`) of any non-personal organization, ownership must be transferred or the user removed from the organization before deletion.
7. Deletes all associated projects, collaborator bindings, and membership requests.
8. Deletes the user's SSO `ProviderUser` bindings.

204.description: No Content: user soft-deleted successfully (empty response body)

401.description: Unauthorized: missing or invalid authentication credentials

403.description: Forbidden: insufficient permissions to delete this user

example.message: no permission to delete the user

404.description: Not Found: target user does not exist

409.description: Conflict: cannot delete the root user (`root`), or the target user is still an administrator of a non-personal organization

get.description: Returns the specified user's most recently created API Key. If the user has no API Key, a new key named `API Key` is automatically generated and returned. Only active (enabled) users are supported, as API Keys are revoked upon user deactivation.

200.description: OK: returns the user's latest API Key

401.description: Unauthorized: missing or invalid authentication credentials

404.description: Not Found: target user does not exist

409.description: Conflict: target user is deactivated (API Keys are revoked upon deactivation)

post.description: Creates an organization workspace (`type = TEAM`) and optionally assigns an owner. When `owner` is omitted, ownership defaults to the root user. The designated owner joins the organization with the `OWNER` role. The organization `username` is globally unique and case-insensitive.

username.description: Organization `username` (required): 1–25 characters; letters, digits, `-`, and `_` only; globally unique and case-insensitive

owner.description: Owner's `username` (optional): defaults to the root user; the specified user must be active

profile.description: Organization profile metadata (optional), including institution, location, bio, school, and contact email

401.description: Unauthorized: missing or invalid authentication credentials

404.description: Not Found: the specified owner user does not exist

409.description: Conflict: the organization `username` already exists, or the specified owner user is deactivated

post.description:
Binds a SwanLab user to an external account under an enabled SSO identity provider (`Provider`).

Non-idempotent: binding the same `(provider, providerUserId)` pair again returns `409 Conflict`. To rebind, first remove the existing binding via `POST /self_hosted/sso/bind/del`.

provider.description: SSO Provider identifier (required; the provider must be enabled)

providerUserId.description: Unique user identifier (Subject / User ID) from the external identity provider (required)

201.description: Created: account bound successfully (empty response body)

401.description: Unauthorized: missing or invalid authentication credentials

404.description: Not Found: target user does not exist (unregistered or deactivated), or the specified Provider does not exist / is disabled

409.description: Conflict: the external account is already bound to another SwanLab user, or the target user already has a binding under this Provider

servers.description: Self-hosted instance (replace with your instance domain)

post.description:
Removes the SSO binding between the specified SwanLab user and external account. The `(username, provider, providerUserId)` tuple must match exactly; any mismatch (e.g., if the external account is bound to a different user) returns `404 Not Found`.

Unlike the bind endpoint, this endpoint does not require the Provider to be enabled or the user to be active, allowing administrators to clean up residual bindings for disabled providers or deactivated users.

provider.description: SSO Provider identifier (required; whether enabled or disabled)

providerUserId.description: Unique user identifier from the external identity provider (required)

204.description: No Content: account unbound successfully (empty response body)

401.description: Unauthorized: missing or invalid authentication credentials

404.description: Not Found: Provider does not exist, user does not exist, or no matching binding tuple was found

servers.description: Self-hosted instance (replace with your instance domain)

post.description: Exchange an OAuth2 `authorization_code` for an `access_token` and `refresh_token`, or use a `refresh_token` to issue a new `access_token`.

code.description: Authorization code received at the callback URL (required when `grant_type=authorization_code`)

refresh_token.description: Refresh token used to obtain a new access token (required when `grant_type=refresh_token`)

200.description: OK: access token issued or refreshed successfully

refresh_token.description: OAuth2 refresh token, valid for 30 days (returned only when `grant_type=authorization_code`)

expires_in.description: Access token lifetime in seconds, fixed at `7200`

400.description: `bad_request`: malformed request body or unsupported `grant_type`; `error_code`: authorization code is invalid, expired, or already redeemed; `error_token`: `refresh_token` is invalid or expired

example.description: invalid request body or unsupported grant_type

401.description: `unauthorized`: missing Basic Auth header, invalid `app_secret`, or the `code` / `refresh_token` does not belong to the requesting application

example.description: missing Basic auth, invalid app_secret, or the code / refresh token does not belong to this application

500.description: `parse_error`: failed to parse JSON payload; `random_error`: token generation failed; `database_error`: persistence operation failed

get.description: Retrieve the authenticated SwanLab user's public profile using a valid `access_token`.

example.description: missing token or malformed Authorization header
access token does not exist or has expired

500.description: `error_internal`: failed to fetch user info; `parse_error`: failed to parse token payload; `database_error`: storage operation failed

200.description: OK: successfully retrieved the API Key

example.description: missing token or malformed Authorization header
access token does not exist or has expired

500.description: `error_internal`: failed to fetch API Key; `parse_error`: failed to parse token payload; `database_error`: storage operation failed
